subject: ONE male barn owl, round glasses on his beak
second_characters: ONE chubby hamster in an apron, owl-shoulder tall
props: ONE floor scale: platform, round dial, ONE needle, no digits; a tower of twine-tied encyclopedia bundles; ONE gold coin; ONE baling press
environment: sunny waste-paper yard walled by towering paper bales, no sky; scraps whirling, bales tumbling
lighting: blazing noon sun, glints on glasses
motion_rule: the world flies at the owl, he answers with his WHOLE body every beat. In speech beats the hamster works in the near foreground. Bale walls fill the background. He fills half the frame height, except the three close-up beats where a face or object fills the whole frame. The camera moves and changes angle and shot size every beat.

audio.pacing: first word at 0.4; no words 2.05-2.65 and 5.55-6.15; last word by 6.80; no words after 7.0
audio.lip_sync: the owl speaks, beak opening on every syllable
audio.pronunciation: ya vsyu ZHIZN' so-bi-RAL MUD-rost'. DU-mal, E-ta pa-MO-zhet na-ka-PIT' na PEN-si-yu. a-SHIP-sya

timeline.a: close-up: a bundle flies at him; he springs up, catches it in both wings, lunges into the lens, glasses and spine filling the frame
he lands, spins half a turn; near foreground: the hamster dumps newspapers
he hops sideways onto the swaying tower; near foreground: the hamster jerks a SECOND bundle overhead
the hamster hurls it at the owl; he catches it with his chest, drops onto the scale, needle jolting
his head swivels 270 degrees to the hamster, body following
with a wing-clap he leaps to the tower top; sheets rain over the camera
he drops onto the scale, needle sweeping round; press jaws slam
timeline.c: behind the dial, needle in front

timeline.a: he swings to the dial and leans on it; near foreground: the hamster squints at the needle
close-up: the hamster pulls ONE gold coin from his apron, bites it, lunges into the lens, muzzle and coin filling the frame
he lunges sideways, snatches the coin from the hamster's paw and spins; the hamster tumbles back
the camera hurls itself from far to his face in one move; he flips the coin into his beak, glasses sliding to the tip
the hamster yanks the stack from under him and kicks it into the press; the owl tumbles backward, head locked on the camera
timeline.c: behind the press, jaws in front

timeline.a: he bursts from the scrap cloud, coin in beak, cheeks puffed; the press spits a tiny cube of crushed encyclopedias
close-up: he lunges into the lens and swallows the coin whole like a mouse, face filling the frame

must_appear: frame-filling close-ups at 0.00, 5.55, 9.20; 7.60 stack into the press
negative_prompt: text, digits, subtitles, signage, night, empty sky, an empty yard, a frozen pose, a hero running at the camera, zoom, slow push-in, static wide shot, a closed beak while speaking, a line said twice, a stuttered word, an inserted word, speech after 7.0, foreign accent, feminine word endings, neuter word endings, a second coin, belt, conveyor, rail, trolley, cart
